en-US.longDescription: Thanks to enthusiast feedback, GPU Tweak III now features a revamped interface that puts core functions at the forefront, and the VF Tuner has been overhauled to make manual overclocking much easier. Meanwhile, exclusive features like 0dB fan technology are now enhanced by automatic profile swapping and logging of monitoring sessions. Whats more? Now you can monitor more system stats with the plugin and customize GT3 with your choice of interface background and color.
en-US.name: GPU Tweak III (Stable)
